lines.text: Hi, I'm Spacey, your guide to RELIC. Let me show you the main controls, then you can explore at your own pace.
Open Worlds to choose a planet, moon, or comet. You can also select a world directly in the solar system.
Let's visit Earth. I'll lock the view onto the planet so we can explore its surface and its nearby worlds.
These four buttons share your view, switch between vertical and tilted views, turn north upward, and recenter the whole planet.
World Data brings together the planet's key facts, its moons and orbits, and exploration sites and missions.
Display controls the scene and image. Adjust stars, lighting, labels, and visual effects here. Available controls depend on the current world.
Location finds a place or coordinates on this world. Visual Presets changes the image style. You can return to Normal at any time.
Select the RELIC logo to return to the solar system. You're ready to explore. Select me whenever you'd like to replay this tour.
